cohort: 19 women diagnosed with AFLP over a 6-year period
finding: The study found a higher maternal mortality rate (21%) associated with AFLP compared to other studies, highlighting the need for early detection and management of this condition.
gest_age: Mean gestational age was 37 weeks, with 68.42% of women at or beyond 37 weeks.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in 65% of newborns.
